claim: Portrait battle cards preserve exact health, charge, ready-state and whole-card skill interaction behavior.
artifact_or_command: godot --headless --path project-a --script tools/run_battle_hud_layout_tests.gd && godot --headless --path project-a --script tools/run_ui_smoke_tests.gd

assertions: Two raster portrait cards retain exact unit IDs and whole-card skill targets.
Health, charge and ready styling update from the shipping battle snapshot.
Six cards keep independent skill targets without changing battle commands.

observation: Battle HUD layout and UI smoke suites pass with portrait cards, paired bars and touch-sized skill targets.
inference: The portrait redesign preserves the shipping battle interaction contract.
limitations: Headless assertions do not measure human reaction speed.
